mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting from tightening to easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and compressing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) exceeding 2% month-over-month indicates weakening labor market demand, reducing investor confidence and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in demand-weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) below 2% month-over-month signals strengthening labor demand, boosting investor sentiment and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in demand-strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 112.6889 over 2 consecutive months indicates expanding supply capacity, which compresses marginal costs and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in supply-expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 112.6889 over 2 consecutive months signals contracting supply capacity, raising marginal costs and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL index above 207.387 over 3 consecutive months indicates accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain higher rates, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in inflationary periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 207.387 over 3 consecutive months signals accelerating inflation, which erodes real equity returns and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in inflationary periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
